snapshots.profile_text: Kiwibank 11.1K posts Kiwibank @KiwibankNZ The bank helping Kiwi be better off 🌿 This account is no longer active. For support, call us on 0800 11 33 55 or message via Secure Mail in your mobile app 💚 New Zealand kiwibank.co.nz Joined May 2009 1,663 Following 10.4K Followers Posts Replies Media Kiwibank @KiwibankNZ Jan 7, 2018 Today we're remembering the man who was responsible for the very creation of Kiwibank, Jim Anderton. Thank you, Jim, from all of us. Kiwibank @KiwibankNZ Jan 27, 2021 Replying to @Phil_Wheeler Hi Phil. We condemn racism in any form. We've removed our ads on the Magic Talk website and we'll be talking directly with MediaWorks on how they could better encourage a diverse and inclusive NZ. Thanks, Amy Kiwibank @KiwibankNZ Jul 5, 2015 Who’s @jaamiecurry? She's a cool Kiwi & we’re following her journey from her mum’s house to the big smoke. amp.twimg.com/v/ecc94877-c9a… Kiwibank @KiwibankNZ Aug 21, 2022 Announced today, the Government has acquired 100% of Kiwibank, meaning we’ll remain 100% Kiwi owned. There’s no change for customers and we’ll continue to operate as an independent organisation with profits remaining here in NZ. kiwibank.co.nz Kiwibank looks to the future as Government confirms it will remain in public hands | News & updates Kiwibank today welcomed the news that it would remain in public ownership, with the Government announcing that it has acquired 100 percent of Kiwibank’s parent company Kiwi Group Holdings. Kiwibank @KiwibankNZ Feb 13, 2019 Mike King wins the Kiwibank 2019 New Zealander of the Year Award!!😀🏆 Mike is a passionate and dedicated mental health advocate, tackling issues of depression, alcohol and drug abuse and suicide in NZ. Congratulations Mike and thank you for making Aotearoa a better place! #nzoty Kiwibank @KiwibankNZ Aug 16, 2015 Ep 5 of #TheKBSeries! Real life is a wakeup call for @jaamiecurry. At least it’s snowing in her laundry (kind of). amp.twimg.com/v/8df10494-e10… Kiwibank @KiwibankNZ Aug 2, 2015 It's ep 3 of @jaamiecurry's #TheKBSeries. It's time to kick out the old to make room for the new…(Sorry, Aaron). amp.twimg.com/v/20ffdf65-150… Kiwibank @KiwibankNZ Aug 9, 2015 Ep 4 of @jaamiecurry's #TheKBSeries is here. Jamie hits the shops, and gets a visit from some supernatural mates. amp.twimg.com/v/6b9c181c-428… Kiwibank @KiwibankNZ Jan 2, 2022 Kia ora. We know it can be really challenging to save for a house deposit, and we recognise this narrative misses the mark. We’re updating this page today. Appreciate you raising this with us. Thanks, Amy Kiwibank @KiwibankNZ Jul 22, 2020 Replying to @NewsroomNZ and @NikkiMandow Following feedback on our Responsible Business Banking Policy we'll recategorize the adult entertainment industry as a sensitive sector and continue to bank businesses in this sector who demonstrate good practice. We’ll work together with @NZPC_ to develop this further. Kiwibank @KiwibankNZ Feb 14, 2017 Taika Waititi’s films show us a vision of NZ that we don’t always
